parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token to ensure that the request is idempotent. The token must be unique for each request. It is case-sensitive and can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: Extensions
parameters.description: The extensions to uninstall. Separate multiple extension names with a comma (,).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the endpoint is located.
